verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions API versioning (such as compatibility dates or versioned endpoints) or any documented deprecation policy for the Cloudflare or Workers APIs. The Worker version rollback (wrangler rollback) concerns the user's own deployments, not versioned platform APIs, and does not count. An OpenAPI spec existing does not establish versioning or deprecation guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
